description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be discontinued.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. **ClientToken** can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 数据同步实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The ID of the region where the data synchronization instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh: 任务ID，调用[ModifySynchronizationObject](~~49451~~)接口修改同步对象时会返回该值。
description.en: The task ID, which is returned when you call the [ModifySynchronizationObject](~~49451~~) operation to modify synchronization objects.

title.zh: 查询修改同步对象任务的执行状态
title.en: Query the execution status of a modify synchronization object task
